overview: The School Committee met to review various educational grants and pilots, including a $15,000 award for the Empower program and reports on the Global Scholars and Online Be Good Academy. The committee also discussed the transition to the Next Generation MCAS accountability system and staffing vacancies.

items.title: Approval of Minutes
items.summary: Approved the October 2 minutes with amendments concerning robotics engineering and committee action plans.

items.title: Bills, Transfers, and Payrolls
items.summary: Approved the payment of bills and payrolls following a question regarding an Attorney General opiate prevention grant.

items.title: Public Participation regarding Open Meeting Law
items.summary: The chair responded to public concerns regarding a Chapter 74 advisory board Open Meeting Law violation, stating that the issue had been resolved with future meetings posted properly.

items.title: Nellie Mae Education Foundation Grant
items.summary: The committee recognized Tim Klein for winning the $15,000 Lawrence O'Toole Educator Leadership Award for the 'Empower' student-centered learning program.

items.title: Online Be Good Academy Report
items.summary: Students from Andrews Middle School presented on social media safety training; the committee approved expanding the presentation to McGlynn Middle School students.

items.title: Global Scholars Program and Paris Symposium
items.summary: Approved the Superintendent's attendance at a Bloomberg Philanthropies symposium in Paris to discuss global digital curriculum outcomes.

items.title: Buddy Bench and Kiwanis Book Donations
items.summary: Accepted a memorial bench for Brooks Elementary and a summer reading book donation for primary grades from the Kiwanis Club.

items.title: Professional Development Day Report
items.summary: Reviewed plans for the November 7 training day, which focuses on Response to Intervention (RTI) and behavioral screening tools.

items.title: Elementary Science Program Pilot
items.summary: Received an update on the piloting of McGraw-Hill and FOSS science curricula across the elementary schools.

items.title: Vocational Technical Advisory Committee Report
items.summary: Placed on file a report regarding Chapter 74 advisory committees, co-op placements, and meeting posting requirements.

items.title: Selection of MASC Delegates and Condolences
items.summary: Tabled the selection of conference delegates and observed a moment of silence for several deceased community members and former employees.

items.title: North Medford High School Bus Occupancy
items.summary: The committee requested detailed occupancy data and reports on the new bus pass monitoring system to address overcrowding concerns.

items.title: McGlynn Behavioral Specialist Vacancy
items.summary: Staff explained that while a behaviorist vacancy exists at McGlynn, other district specialists are covering required IEP services and evaluations.

items.title: Next Generation MCAS Results Transition
items.summary: District staff reviewed the new MCAS scoring categories and explained that current school accountability levels are based primarily on participation rates during this baseline year.
